1445-2267-4871-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4871-7272.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4279-6026-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6026-6794--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3110-5078-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Council of the Absolute.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

1308-4365-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Anointed Procession and Mondrak.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1308-4365-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

1580-3220-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-2642-4050-7417.easyPrerequisites: There are valid targets for the prepared spell.
1170-2642-4050-7417.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Sanar, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the prepared spell.
Repeat from step 1

1445-3967-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-3967-4871-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4871-6705-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1171-1409-4927.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-1251-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1636-3698-4023-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-3698-4023-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it, Grinding Station and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

955-1170-1329-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1805-1978-4324.description:
Animate Pyramid of the Pantheon using Workshop Elders.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-5073-5220-6273.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

132-3525-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
132-3525-4002.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

1350-3609-6788.manaNeeded: {2}{W} plus {2} in two different colors each turn
1350-3609-6788.description:
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding one mana of any color and causing the next artifact spell you cast to have sunburst.
Cast Magistrate's Scepter by paying {3} using three different colors of mana.
Magistrate's Scepter's sunburst ability triggers, causing it to enter with three charge counters on it.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {1}{U}, returning Magistrate's Scepter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
1350-3609-6788.notes: When adding mana in step 1, you should ensure that whatever color of mana you add will allow you to pay three different colors of mana while casting Magistrate's Scepter. If you already have three different colors of mana available, you can add {W} to pay for Meticulous Excavation instead.

1680-4508-5880-6441.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1651-3715-5365-6291.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-5365-6291.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clue and Thopter, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

1525-5751-6504-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
1525-5751-6504-6747.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

4929-5200-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had three nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
4929-5200-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

2730-2921-6553.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2730-2921-6553.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

654-880-3534.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-3534.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5147-6103-6105.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Resolve all abilities from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target for each one.
Repeat from 3.

603-5231-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
603-5231-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3284-4550-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-3284-4550-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

2082-2921-4186.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Scurry Oak.
2082-2921-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2082-2921-4186.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

567-2919-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
567-2919-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1636-2734.notablePrerequisites:
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
643-1636-2734.description:
Cast Cyberdrive Awakener by paying {5}{U}.
When Cyberdrive Awakener enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing Maskwood Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1558-2963-4772-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1497-3284-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {R/G}.
Korvold's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw Wild Cantor from the top of your library.
Cast Wild Cantor by paying {R/G}.
Repeat.

1340-4013-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1340-4013-4929.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Tanazir.
Tanazir enters the battlefield, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2816-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Vhal by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1152-1528.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature without summoning sickness you control.
1152-1528.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed with any target and hold priority.
Activate the enchanted creature by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Traitorous Greed and targeting the enchanted creature with the copy.
Resolve the spell copy, untapping enchanted creature and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

704-2034-4215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Elvish Soultiller, adding {C}{C}.
Elvish Soultiller dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Elvish Soultiller trigger, shuffling all Elves or Mutants from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Elvish Soultiller, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
